daily.today_energy: Mercury in Scorpio is giving you detective energy—you're picking up on things others miss. With the Moon in Gemini, your mind is restless but sharp. Channel that into solving problems instead of overthinking.
daily.love: Venus in Libra wants balance and harmony, which speaks your language. If you've been holding back saying something important, today's vibe supports honest conversations. Keep it real but kind.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying ambition across the board. Use this to push a project forward or pitch that idea you've been sitting on. Your practical approach + current momentum = results.
daily.health: The Moon-Mars square might make you feel a bit wired. Ground yourself with movement—a walk, yoga, or even cleaning works. Your nervous system needs the outlet more than usual today.

By Friday, Mars enters Virgo and suddenly you've got momentum. Best Day: Saturday. Watch-Out Day: Wednesday.
weekly.love: Venus in Libra keeps things diplomatic, but Mars entering Virgo Friday flips the script. Early week, communication feels stilted—say what you mean, don't hint. Midweek tension might spark necessary conversations. By the weekend, Mars gives you the confidence to actually pursue what you want instead of analyzing it to death. Single? Finally ready to put yourself out there.
weekly.career: The Sun-Mars square midweek highlights friction between your ideas and execution—that's not failure, that's clarity. Mercury in Scorpio helps you dig into details everyone else missed. When Mars enters Virgo Friday, your work energy shifts from scattered to surgical. Projects accelerate. This is your window to propose that thing you've been sitting on. Momentum is real by Saturday.

Mars entering Virgo Friday reignites your natural drive to optimize and refine. Perfect time to restart that routine you abandoned or finally commit to something sustainable. Saturday onwards, your body actually wants to work with you again.
